figures.heading: Customer on a deactivated term

figures.heading: Edit Customer: COD or Credit Hold locks the limit
captions: On COD or Credit Hold the Credit Limit is $0 and disabled, with the hover "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit."
On touch screens a tap on the locked Credit Limit shows the same explanation as text under the field (r14-03).
Any other term keeps the limit editable (the Net 10 customer above shows $5,000.00); blank means no limit.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).
